The keel was laid by Bhavesh Bajaj, Management Consultant, Polestar Maritime Limited, in the presence of Jose V.J., Chairman and Managing Director of CSL.
Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) has laid the keel for the first of two ASTDS 70T Bollard Pull Tugs being built for Mumbai-based Polestar Maritime Limited.
The tugs will be equipped with two main engines rated at 1,838 kW and 2.7-metre propellers supplied by Niigata IHI Power Systems Co. Ltd. The vessels are based on designs developed by Robert Allan Limited, which specialises in harbour tugs. The current order book of the CSL group comprises 17 ASTDS tugs and six green tugs.
The keel was laid by Bhavesh Bajaj, management consultant, Polestar, in the presence of Jose V.J., chairman and managing director, CSL.
“In partnership with Polestar Maritime Limited, CSL is also constructing two GTTP tugs under the Government of India’s Green Tug Transition Programme,” said Mr. Jose.
